claims: Participating U.S. Wendy's offer a free Small Fry and Small Frosty (chocolate or vanilla) on Tuesday, April 7, 2026.
No purchase is necessary for the offer.
No app is required for the offer.
The offer is only available in-restaurant or in the drive-thru.
The offer is available while supplies last.
The offer provides one free small fry and one small Frosty per person.
The offer is available at participating U.S. Wendy's in-store and drive-thru only.
The promotion is part of Wendy's "Free Dunks for America" campaign.
Wendy's "Free Dunks for America" campaign celebrates the NCAA Basketball Championship.
